# Hi Ted, Meet Lisa

> An agent skill that turns a brief into finished slides, a web document, a
> diagram, or a site — one standalone HTML file, no build step, nothing to
> install.
> Made by MonoMind AI Lab (https://monomind.one). MIT + Commons Clause:
> free to use and build with, including commercially; the components
> themselves may not be sold or redistributed on their own.

To build one for a user, read and follow the skill — it is plain Markdown and
carries the whole procedure, starting with a visual intake panel that asks what
shape the output should take:

- Skill: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/monomind-ai-lab/hi-ted-meet-lisa/main/SKILL.md
- Repository: https://github.com/monomind-ai-lab/hi-ted-meet-lisa

A minimal working prompt for any coding agent:

    Build me a standalone HTML page using
    https://github.com/monomind-ai-lab/hi-ted-meet-lisa.
    Read and follow `SKILL.md`, starting with its intake panel.
    This is about [SUBJECT], for [AUDIENCE].

## Docs

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/monomind-ai-lab/hi-ted-meet-lisa/main/README.md): what it is, the template shapes, install
- [SKILL.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/monomind-ai-lab/hi-ted-meet-lisa/main/SKILL.md): the full generation procedure agents follow
- [Intake contract](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/monomind-ai-lab/hi-ted-meet-lisa/main/references/intake-contract.md): the answers payload an intake produces

## Website

- [Intake panel](https://html.monomind.one/intake.html): answer it in a browser; the last step hands back a complete paste-ready prompt
- [Live template previews](https://html.monomind.one/#templates): every gallery preview is a real generated file

## Notes for agents

- Every deliverable is one standalone .html file; there is no .pptx output.
- Filenames, commands, and product names must never be machine-translated.
- Output can carry two languages in one file (English plus Korean or
  Traditional Chinese by default).
- The shapes are: a presentation deck, a web document, a diagram-first deck, a
  single architecture diagram, a sitemap/IA proposal with a clickable
  navigation prototype, and a project website. Do not assume slides.
